CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_newjersey_order(p_order jsonb, p_items jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  saved_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;
  saved_item_id uuid;
  customer_uuid uuid;
  item jsonb;
  production_subtotal numeric := 0;
  order_design_fee numeric := 0;
  item_design_fee numeric;
  item_quantity integer;
  jobs_count integer := 0;
BEGIN
  IF jsonb_typeof(p_order) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
     OR jsonb_typeof(p_items) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid order input';
  END IF;

  IF jsonb_array_length(p_items) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Order requires between 1 and 100 configurations';
  END IF;

  customer_uuid :=
    NULLIF(p_order->>'customer_id', '')::uuid;

  IF customer_uuid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Customer account is required';
  END IF;

  -- Calculate order totals from the server-prepared items.
  FOR item IN
    SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items)
  LOOP
    IF jsonb_typeof(item) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid order item';
    END IF;

    item_quantity := (item->>'quantity')::integer;
    item_design_fee := (item->>'design_fee')::numeric;

    IF item_quantity IS NULL
       OR item_quantity NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid item quantity';
    END IF;

    IF item_design_fee IS NULL
       OR item_design_fee < 0
       OR item_design_fee > 9999999999 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid design fee';
    END IF;

    IF item->>'artwork_type' IS NULL
       OR item->>'artwork_type' NOT IN (
         'customer-supplied',
         'design-needed'
       ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid artwork type';
    END IF;

    IF item->>'artwork_type' = 'customer-supplied'
       AND item_design_fee <> 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Customer-supplied artwork must have no design fee';
    END IF;

    IF (item->>'base_price')::numeric IS NULL
       OR (item->>'options_total')::numeric IS NULL
       OR (item->>'unit_price')::numeric IS NULL
       OR (item->>'total_price')::numeric IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Missing production pricing';
    END IF;

    IF (item->>'base_price')::numeric < 0
       OR (item->>'options_total')::numeric < 0
       OR (item->>'unit_price')::numeric < 0
       OR (item->>'total_price')::numeric < 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid production pricing';
    END IF;

    IF (item->>'unit_price')::numeric <>
       round(
         (item->>'base_price')::numeric
         + (item->>'options_total')::numeric,
         2
       ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid unit price';
    END IF;

    IF (item->>'total_price')::numeric <>
       round(
         (item->>'unit_price')::numeric * item_quantity,
         2
       ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid production total';
    END IF;

    production_subtotal :=
      production_subtotal + (item->>'total_price')::numeric;

    -- Add once per configuration, never multiplied by quantity.
    order_design_fee :=
      order_design_fee + item_design_fee;

    jobs_count := jobs_count + item_quantity;
  END LOOP;

  production_subtotal := round(production_subtotal, 2);
  order_design_fee := round(order_design_fee, 2);

  IF (p_order->>'subtotal')::numeric
       IS DISTINCT FROM production_subtotal
     OR (p_order->>'design_fee')::numeric
       IS DISTINCT FROM order_design_fee
     OR (p_order->>'item_count')::integer
       IS DISTINCT FROM jobs_count THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Order totals do not match its items';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.orders (
    customer_id,
    order_number,
    customer_full_name,
    customer_phone,
    customer_email,
    customer_organization,
    delivery_method,
    delivery_state,
    delivery_city,
    delivery_address,
    delivery_landmark,
    project_name,
    preferred_deadline,
    production_instructions,
    item_count,
    subtotal,
    design_fee,
    delivery_fee,
    final_total,
    status
  )
  VALUES (
    customer_uuid,
    p_order->>'order_number',
    p_order->>'customer_full_name',
    p_order->>'customer_phone',
    p_order->>'customer_email',
    p_order->>'customer_organization',
    p_order->>'delivery_method',
    p_order->>'delivery_state',
    p_order->>'delivery_city',
    p_order->>'delivery_address',
    p_order->>'delivery_landmark',
    p_order->>'project_name',
    NULLIF(p_order->>'preferred_deadline', '')::date,
    p_order->>'production_instructions',
    jobs_count,
    production_subtotal,
    order_design_fee,
    0,
    NULL,
    p_order->>'status'
  )
  RETURNING * INTO saved_order;

  FOR item IN
    SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items)
  LOOP
    INSERT INTO public.order_items (
      order_id,
      cart_item_id,
      product_id,
      product_slug,
      product_name,
      product_image,
      quantity,
      base_price,
      options_total,
      unit_price,
      total_price,
      selections,
      artwork_type,
      design_fee
    )
    VALUES (
      saved_order.id,
      item->>'cart_item_id',
      item->>'product_id',
      item->>'product_slug',
      item->>'product_name',
      item->>'product_image',
      (item->>'quantity')::integer,
      (item->>'base_price')::numeric,
      (item->>'options_total')::numeric,
      (item->>'unit_price')::numeric,
      (item->>'total_price')::numeric,
      item->'selections',
      item->>'artwork_type',
      (item->>'design_fee')::numeric
    )
    RETURNING id INTO saved_item_id;

    IF item->>'artwork_type' = 'customer-supplied' THEN
      INSERT INTO public.order_artworks (
        order_id,
        order_item_id,
        status
      )
      VALUES (
        saved_order.id,
        saved_item_id,
        'pending'
      );
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'id', saved_order.id,
    'orderNumber', saved_order.order_number,
    'status', saved_order.status,
    'subtotal', saved_order.subtotal,
    'designFee', saved_order.design_fee,
    'estimatedTotal',
      saved_order.subtotal + saved_order.design_fee,
    'createdAt', saved_order.created_at
  );
END;
$function$
